Permanent. Setup.
If the number of war counters here is at least:
• 1[per_hero] — The Punisher gains steady.
• 2[per_hero] — The Punisher gets +1 SCH and +1 ATK.
• 4[per_hero] — The Punisher gains 1[per_hero] hazard icon ([hazard]).
• 6[per_hero] — Threat cannot be removed from the main scheme.
